dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature with a small irregular notch at the posterior base insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Apex is characterized by a small pixel radius, resulting in a slightly rounded acute shape.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Leading edge displays a smooth convex curve with a steep angular ascent relative to the dorsal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Measured height of the fin is approximately 0.85 times the longitudinal width of the base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular white depigmentation or lesion visible at the trailing edge base of the dorsal fin; several dark, circular punctate marks visible on the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Cluster of dark circular spots (maculae) localized on the flank below the dorsal fin.
